text: kirchner.cv becomes a professional site rather than a text page: a two-column About with portrait card, general-information panel and the CV shown in a PDF.js document viewer ported from lawsofexistence.com and re-skinned in navy and brass; a Work section presenting six published Codified Democratic Order pieces in the same viewer with a card index and per-piece reader pages; a Contact page. The CV PDF is generated at build from cv.json so the viewer and the data cannot drift, and the validator now covers the works list. Gates green; the offscreen render tool cannot paint pdf.js pages (no requestAnimationFrame), proven with a control page.
